evaluation.results_summary: The developer reports that StableLM 2 1.6B was, at the time of the report's publication, the leading open model under 2B parameters by a substantial margin. The model is positioned as a foundational base model intended for application-specific fine-tuning.

possible_risks.description: Copyrighted information or other intellectual property might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight base model pre-trained on The Pile without Books3 and other open-source datasets; downstream users can prompt it with copyrighted text, and the card does not report any filtering or guard against IP in prompts.

possible_risks.description: Confidential information might be included as a part of the prompt that is sent to the model.
possible_risks.justification: open-weight text model positioned for fine-tuning and downstream use; no stated safeguards or data handling controls, so users may include confidential information in prompts.

possible_risks.description: Hallucinations generate factually inaccurate or untruthful content relative to the model's training data or input. Hallucinations are also sometimes referred to lack of faithfulness or lack of groundedness. In some instances, synthetic data that is generated by large language models might include hallucinations that result in the data possibly being inaccurate, fabricated, or disconnected from reality. Hallucinations can compromise model performance, accuracy, and relevance.
possible_risks.justification: dense decoder-only text model with no reported factual grounding or evaluation; base models can generate factually inaccurate content.

possible_risks.description: AI, and large generative models in particular, might produce increased carbon emissions and increase water usage for their training and operation.
possible_risks.justification: pretrained 12B-parameter dense model on large open-source corpora; training such a model implies substantial compute and energy/water use, and the card reports no environmental metrics.

specifications.model_size: 22.6 GiB of safetensors weights (24,286,613,840 bytes) in BF16

training_context.adaptations: The Stable LM 2 family received post-training through supervised fine-tuning, direct preference optimization, and self-knowledge learning; the model card also recommends fine-tuning the base Stable LM 2 12B for downstream tasks.
training_context.training_data: The Stable LM 2 12B checkpoint was pre-trained on a filtered mixture of open-source datasets from the HuggingFace Hub, including Falcon RefinedWeb, RedPajama-Data, The Pile without Books3, and StarCoder.
